summary: Iter 27b/27c/P2/P3 end-to-end verified. Backend pytest 16/16 green on test_iteration28.py, and full regression across iter22/23/25/26/27 passes 63/63 with PYTHONPATH=/app/backend. Frontend flows all confirmed live via Playwright on the preview URL: /public + /verify unauth pages, cert-verify with the seeded code returns valid-green result and junk code returns invalid, admin mind map at /courses/1/mindmap renders a react-flow radial graph (25 nodes, Regenerate + Topics dropdown + Back button work, toast 'Generated 6 topics'), CourseEditPage exposes mindmap-btn + green pptx-download-btn, PPTX download produced a valid 33KB .pptx (PK zip magic), /tokens shows the 30-day SVG usage chart with total_calls / total_errors indicators + Top tokens list, and the CreateModal SCOPE dropdown offers 'read:catalog'. issues: React Flow logs a warning 'parent container needs a width and a height' on initial mount before layout settles. Non-blocking (nodes still render), but could be silenced by setting explicit h/w on the ReactFlowProvider wrapper.

critical_code_review_comments: Regression pytest suites (test_iteration22/23/25/26/27) require PYTHONPATH=/app/backend to run because they import 'services.*' directly. Consider adding a conftest.py at /app/backend/tests that inserts /app/backend into sys.path, or a pytest.ini rootdir setting, so future CI/testing agents don't hit ModuleNotFoundError. Not a functional bug, but a test-infra papercut.
